facts: Parties: Upton Pharma plc (Buyer), Calloway Foods Ltd (Seller); the Company is Arden Industries Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 18 April 2026; Closing is scheduled for 28 May 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,650,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Juniper Capital LLP threatening proceedings for approximately $450,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Corrib Foods Ltd.
